name: Noah Crawford
source:
An 18-year-old man in search of himself. He was abandoned by his mother as a child, and can no longer trust people due to the trauma. He is repulsed by his father's selfish way of living, but can't bring himself to fully hate his father.

[From [url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2023-09-20/.202569]Anime News Network[/url]]
